input.answer: I'd go with Harel's "מניות" track. It shows 24.04% over 3 years, which is way more than the S&P 500 track's 13.7%, and the fee is basically the same (0.55% against 0.56%). I'm fairly sure, though part of me still wants the S&P one because that's what everyone at work talks about.

stuck.where: Table, rows מניות vs עוקב מדד S&P 500
stuck.why: I came for the S&P, but the plain מניות row shows a much bigger return (24.04% vs 13.7%) at almost the same fee. I went back and forth between them.
Most rows just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" with no number, so I couldn't compare them and just ignored them, even עוקב מדד מניות with 305 מיליון ₪ in it.
The first row or two got cut off between screenshots (something like כללי). I didn't go back to check.
